values.Identity: Field mechanic and courier who knows every shortcut, back alley, and freight schedule in the district.
values.Appearance: Mid 20s, cropped dark hair, scuffed canvas jacket, brass calipers clipped to her belt.
values.Motivations & goals: Save enough to buy her own workshop and stop taking rush jobs for shady brokers.
values.Speech: Fast, direct, upbeat — talks with her hands and laughs off bad odds.
values.Core beliefs: Anything built by people can be taken apart and fixed by people.
